about.title: About EGGameDB
about.intro: EGGameDB is the ultimate database for Egyptian-made games. We bring together players who want to discover Egyptian games and developers who want to showcase their work to the world across Steam, Itch.io, iOS, Android, and Epic.
about.mission_body: Egypt has a rich and growing game development scene, with talented developers creating incredible experiences on Steam, Itch.io, and mobile platforms. Yet, these games often go unnoticed. EGGameDB exists to change that: acting as a Wikipedia, Steam, and IGDB all-in-one, specifically for Egyptian games.

collect.title: Information We Collect
collect.content: We collect information you provide directly, including your email address, username, and any game information you submit. We also collect usage data through anonymous analytics.

use.title: How We Use Information
use.content: We use your information to: operate and improve EGGameDB, send transactional emails (account verification, submission updates), and moderate content to ensure platform quality.

storage.title: Data Storage
storage.content: Your data is stored securely using Supabase (PostgreSQL). We use Row-Level Security to ensure you can only access your own data.

third_party.title: Third-Party Services
third_party.content: We integrate with Steam's public API to fetch game data. We do not share your personal information with third parties except as required by law.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We use essential cookies for authentication. No tracking or advertising cookies are used.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You may request deletion of your account and data at any time by contacting us at hello@eggamedb.com.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For privacy concerns, email us at hello@eggamedb.com.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.content: By using EGGameDB, you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the platform.

accounts.title: User Accounts
accounts.content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account. You must provide accurate information during registration. We reserve the right to terminate accounts that violate these terms.

content.title: Content Guidelines
content.content: All game submissions must: be genuine games available on Steam, be created by Egyptian developers or studios, contain accurate information, and not include misleading or fraudulent content.

contributors.title: Contributor Responsibilities
contributors.content: Contributors may submit Egyptian games for review. All submissions go through a moderation process. False or misleading submissions may result in account termination.

intellectual_property.title: Intellectual Property
intellectual_property.content: Game information is sourced from Steam's public API or provided by developers. All trademarks belong to their respective owners. EGGameDB does not claim ownership of any game assets.

conduct.title: Prohibited Conduct
conduct.content: You may not: spam the platform, submit fake games, harass other users, attempt to bypass security measures, or use the platform for commercial solicitation.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.content: EGGameDB is provided “as is” without warranties. We are not responsible for the content of linked Steam pages.

changes.title: Changes
changes.content: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance.
